chinese-five-spice-syrup.name: Chinese Five-Spice Syrup
chinese-five-spice-syrup.instructions: Grind spices to a coarse powder. Toast spices in a stainless steel pot until they smoke (a few seconds). Remove from heat while shaking and tossing. Repeat the toasting steps about three more times, until the spices are very aromatic. Add the simple syrup and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low and add the honey. Simmer for five minutes, then remove from heat and let the mixture cool. Strain through a fine mesh strainer. Keeps for up to a month in the refrigerator.
